message: 魔王ＶＳ魔王？

name: Macaron
message: 「Urgh...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I can't believe I couldn't find Big Brother yesterday or the day before...」

name: Macaron
message: 「But I won't give up!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Today's the day I'm definitely gonna find you, Big Brother!」

name: Misa
message: 「Phew. I suppose that should do it for gathering the materials.」

name: Misa
message: 「Knowing Sakura-kun, I'm sure he hasn't prepared any of the documents we need for today's meeting anyway...」

name: Misa
message: 「Ufufu. I'll show him just how much more attentive I am.」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh my...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm, I already came this way earlier...」

name: Misa
message: 「Haaah--!?」

name: Misa
message: 「A-A-A giant Kopinkuma!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「It kind of feels like it's this way... but it also sort of seems like it's over there...」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Oh, it's a costume. Goodness, you startled me...」

name: Misa
message: 「Though, in its own way, that's...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I already went in there earlier, so maybe over there next.」

name: Misa
message: 「No, wait! That girl... doesn't look like one of our students. Could she be lost...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Honestly, Big Brother's got some nerve too. He could at least stay somewhere easier to find...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, whatever, it's not like I'm in any trouble at all, so it's fine.」

name: Misa
message: 「She looks terribly troubled, and as vice president, I can't just look the other way!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Maybe over there...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hello there.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ahh, she really is so cu--」

name: Misa
message: 「Hm, hmph, ahem!」

name: Misa
message: 「What is your name? What are you doing in a place like this?」

name: Macaron
message: 「...I'm looking for someone.」

name: Misa
message: 「Is that so. By someone, do you mean a friend?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm, not quite, I guess.」

name: Macaron
message: 「More importantly... who are you, big sis?」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, excuse me. At times like this, it's proper etiquette to introduce myself first, isn't it.」

name: Misa
message: 「I am Misa B. Cristelis. I serve as the Vice President of the Ryuusei Academy Student Council.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Vice, President?」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yes, that's right. Well, there isn't really much difference between that and the President, though.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then you know the Student Council President?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? Yes...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Awesome, I found a lead! Go me!」

name: Misa
message: 「Were you looking for Sakura-kun?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Something like that!」

name: Misa
message: 「And what business might you have with him?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm, it's a secret! Nobody's allowed to figure out the great Macaron-sama's plans!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Macaron
message: 「So, where do I go to meet the Student Council President?」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's see... We have Student Council activities coming up, so you can't go wrong heading to the Student Council room.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Gotcha, the Student Council room! Thanks!」

name: Misa
message: 「Not at all, you're welcome.」

name: Macaron
message: 「See ya!」

name: Misa
message: 「Even from behind, he looks so wonderful...」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait! If I don't get going too, I'm going to be late for the meeting!」

name: Synn
message: 「What does everyone think about the opinion just raised?」

name: Everyone
message: 「No objectio~ns.」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, this matter is hereby approved~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Awright! That wraps up today's meeting!」

name: Ria
message: 「Good work today, everyone~」

name: Synn
message: 「That was decided faster than I expected.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. Don't forget that it's all thanks to my documents.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, the President had the exact same documents, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Anyway, I'm just glad everything came together so well.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. It's settled, so who cares about the details.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, the meeting's already over.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Zzz, zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, whatever.」

name: Synn
message: 「Guess we'll call it a day here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A~lright, time for club activities~♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh? Come to think of it, Sakura-kun, did you manage to meet up with your friend?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? What are you talking about?」

name: Misa
message: 「Earlier, I ran into a girl who said she was looking for you, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「A girl? Who could that be...」

name: Misa
message: 「She was dressed in a very lovely and adorable outfit, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Now I really have no clue.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's this? A girl looking for Synn?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If that's the case, I actually ran into her yesterday too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Really?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If I remember right, it was when I was waiting to meet up with Sacchin to go sweets-hopping...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Geez. Sacchin, after I told her so many times not to be late...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No choice, guess I'll go meet her halfway--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「On your marks... Nanaka Daaaash!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Wah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ow.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa there! Sorry, sorry, are you okay?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mmh~ geez, watch where you're going!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha... you're so tiny I didn't notice you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, okay, I got it! I'm really sorry. It was totally my bad. Please forgive me!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nfufu. You should've just owned up to it like that from the start.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why are you acting all high and mighty...?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chaaan, what's going ooon?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh~? Who's that kiiid?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No idea. Never seen her around before.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big sisters, you don't know who I am?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nope, never heard of you~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I got it! You must be a celebrity! Not that I've ever heard of you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「W-Well, it can't be helped. Yeah, I'm still just getting started...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're about to make your debut?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Um, something like that... I guess?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Heh~! That's amazing~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Fuhaha! Just you watch! Before long, the name of Lady Macaron will echo far and wide!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oooh~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, what's this pre-debut Macaron-chan doing in a place like this anyway?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, that's right!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm in a hurry! Today's the day I'm definitely going to find them!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Are you looking for someone~?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yep. The Student Council President!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well then! Sorry for bumping into you! You watch where you're going next time too, though!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, she took off...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「What was her deal, I wonder~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She seemed to be looking for Synn, though...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Could it be... I'm sensing a new rival for Nana-chan~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-W-What the heck are you talking about!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「With Synn of all people, there's no way in hell!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Right~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Still, how do I put it, that girl~...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. She had the kind of name that makes you want to take just a liiittle taste...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sure, that girl was cute too, though I feel like she was kinda cheeky.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, ooh!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, I also met someone like this during my exploration yesterday!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh~! So this path connects to a place like this.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With this, I've discovered yet another shortcut to the academy ♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, my butler drives me back and forth, so I won't actually use it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ugh, come on! Why isn't anybody here!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hm? Gah!? An angel!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wha--!? A-A-An angel, I am no such thing!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Liar! Even if you say that, your wings are sticking right out!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hyaaa-wawa...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I don't have any wings...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, hey, why is an angel in a place like this?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Like I said, I'm not an angel!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez, lying is bad, you know. You gotta be more fair and square!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Angels never tell lies!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, so you really are an angel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ha-wawa!? Th-That just now was, um, what you'd call a cat's cradle of speech...」

name: Macaron
message: 「What's that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um, according to the guidebook...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Eh, whatever.」

name: Macaron
message: 「More importantly, why isn't anyone here today?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm? Could it be because today is a day off?」

name: Macaron
message: 「On break? Then what about tomorrow?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Once tomorrow comes, I believe everyone will be here again.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Will the Student Council President come too?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Could it be that you are looking for the President?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm, something like that!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ho-ho. In that case, allow me to lend you a hand!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Really? Oh, so you're actually a nice angel, Angel-chan!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, I'll pass! I'll figure something out on my own.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so. Then I shall refrain from getting involved in any troublesome matters as well.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah. Thanks for telling me!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not at all. Helping someone in need is only natural.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even if you're an angel, you're a nice one, Angel-chan, so maybe I'll let you join my crew someday!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauu, as I keep saying, I am not an angel...\s01」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi. My name's Macaron. Make sure you remember it!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Later!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aaah... she has gone.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, Macaron-san, is it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sounds so sweet and delicious, slurp...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I found myself wanting to take a bite without even thinking.」

name: Ria
message: 「Then could it be that the girl I ran into the other day was her too?」

name: Misa
message: 「You met her as well, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. She seemed a little precocious, though she was a lively kid.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, any idea who she is?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~. I think she's probably the girl working part-time at Old Man Amakawa's place.」
Judging from everyone's accounts, I'm starting to doubt whether they're really talking about Macaron, though.

name: Nanaka
message: 「What the heck, so that's all it was.」

name: Ria
message: 「If she's someone you actually know, then there's no problem.」

name: Misa
message: 「I made sure to let them know she was looking for you, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, thanks.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ack, I left Sacchin waiting!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then, I'm heading off to club!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're sure busy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugya!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Wapuh!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my...?」

name: Ria
message: 「What happened?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ow, ow, ow...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph, geez! Don't just come barreling out like that!」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh? You're...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Macaron!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh, what, what?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey there, Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah! Found you, Big Brother!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Everyone
message: 「Big brother!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez, I've been looking all over for you, Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that right? Hope I didn't cause you too much trouble.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, honestly, it wasn't all that hard at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. You're amazing, Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nufufu, I guess so.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? What's wrong with everyone? Nanaka, what about your club?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's a full-fledged club, not a hobby group!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, right.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not the point! Synn! What on earth is going on here!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「'Big brother,' is it~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So you're one of those hopeless guys who spends his days being indecisive surrounded by a bunch of little sisters, huh.」

name: Misa
message: 「I never heard anything about Sakura-kun having a little sister......」

name: Ria
message: 「Macaron Sakura-chan, huh~. What a cute little sister.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, that's weird! There's no way I wouldn't know about it......」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big brother, what is everyone talking about?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~, I feel like there's some kind of misunderstanding.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, she's your little sister, isn't she?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, a little sister...... something like that?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't tell me--you're not related by blood!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Obviously.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Whaaat--!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hohou. In other words, Mr. President is living under the same roof with a little sister who isn't related to him by blood.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How beastly of you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, no, no, that's not it.」

name: Misa
message: 「F-fufufufu, how filthy! How indecent!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's totally normal, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「No way!? That's bad, Synn-kun! To think a debauched lifestyle has become normal for you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, my lifestyle might be a little rough around the edges, I guess...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! I misjudged you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, why!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Such shamelessness is unbecoming of the Student Council President!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm gonna beat that rotten attitude right out of you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaah! Hold on a second!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Looks like you're having a rough time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron, say something to everyone for me too!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm... got it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「We did make a promise, so I'll help you out.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn! Are you seriously trying to use your little sister as a shield!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How beastly of you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's not it! Everyone, listen!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother is a really good person.」

name: Macaron
message: 「He gladly swore his loyalty to me, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, when?」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-wh-what kind of twisted play are you forcing on her!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Just the other day, he even introduced me to a whole bunch of part-time jobs!」

name: Ria
message: 「How awful!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Making your own little sister work in your place--what the hell is wrong with you!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, you've got it all wrong!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The more you deny it, the more suspicious you look.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're the worst kind of human being!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun... And here I trusted you...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Tehehe... Well, how's that?」

name: Synn
message: 「You made it worse!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez! Why won't anyone listen to what I say!」

name: Synn
message: 「It turned out like this BECAUSE we listened...」

name: Macaron
message: 「If that's how you're gonna play it, I'm resorting to force!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll show you the power of Alzard, the demon sword Lady Macaron inherited from her master!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!? Watch out, watch out!!」
Macaron effortlessly hoists up a kitchen knife taller than she is!

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Sakura-kun! Just what kind of upbringing are you giving her at home!?」

name: Synn
message: 「How should I know!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm, child neglect, is it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Alright, first a practice swing, and...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph!」
A full-force swing that sweeps everything away!

name: Paqy
message: 「Guoh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Obugyah!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aaa~~hyaa~~~~!!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? Did I just hit something?」
Slammed hard by the flat of the kitchen knife, poor Paqy was launched out the window and became a twinkling star.
At that speed, he looked like he'd score a hole-in-one straight into the plaza fountain.

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, Paqy...」
I fall to my knees in despair.

name: Macaron
message: 「Um... sorry, was that something important?」

name: Synn
message: 「...He was a dear friend.」

name: Synn
message: 「He had a foul mouth, sure, but he was a good guy...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Uwahwahwah! Sorry, sorry! I'm really sorry, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I didn't know he meant so much to you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll go look for him right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, hey, Macaron!」

name: Synn
message: 「...She's gone.」
So even my last hope has finally been crushed.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now then... Synn?」

name: Misa
message: 「Perhaps you'd care to explain clearly what is going on here?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See, I told you, Synn--you should've just explained things properly from the start.」

name: Misa
message: 「S-She's right, honestly!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, I believed in you all along, President.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah! After all, Synn is the Student Council President. Right?」
For now, I should just be glad the misunderstanding is cleared up.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, we really can't find that panda, huh.」

name: Ria
message: 「How far did he get sent flying, I wonder?」

name: Misa
message: 「And Macaron is nowhere to be seen either...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She must have gotten hungry and gone home by now.」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron... I wonder what she even wanted in the end.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why not just ask her next time?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, good point.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn, what's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm not sure what's going on...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my? What is that...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that a demon?」

name: Ria
message: 「Looks like it wandered in from somewhere.」

name: Misa
message: 「This is a job for the Crusaders!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's go, everyone!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hehe~n, I finally found it!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Now, I have to hurry and bring it to Big Brother...」

name: Macaron
message: 「This plushie...」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's pretty cool!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aah, no, no! Taking someone else's things is so improper!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, it feels kind of nostalgic...」

name: Yasubee
message: 「Eee!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hm? What was that just now...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, we've got it cornered!」

name: Misa
message: 「Give yourself up!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, everyone. This little guy hasn't done anything bad yet.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It might have done something before we found it, don't you think?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's...」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right. We can't trust something as sketchy as a demon!」
At times like this, I sure wish Paqy were here to translate.

name: Ria
message: 「I mean, I get what Synn-kun is saying, too, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For now, we just gotta drive it away.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hoooold it right there!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wabuh!?」
Something soft comes flying out of the darkness and covers my face.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Paqy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Uun... O-Oh, if it ain't Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're safe.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hyaaah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Mako-chan's here too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank goodness.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big brother, what is the meaning of this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, what do you mean?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Everyone ganging up to bully a demon like that!」

name: Ria
message: 「Bully...?」

name: Misa
message: 「We're not bullying it or anything!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed. After all, this is an act of justice.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I won't listen to any of those excuses!」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's a fact that you were attacking a demon, isn't it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why is Mako-chan getting so mad...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I thought I could trust you, Big Brother... You were the first friend I made in the Human World!」

name: Macaron
message: 「But if you're gonna hurt us demons, I won't forgive you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I, the Demon Lord Macaron, will punish you good!!」

name: Everyone
message: 「D-Demon Lord?!」

name: Macaron
message: 「...W-Well, I mean, I'm still in training right now, though!」

name: Synn
message: 「No way... Macaron is a demon...」

name: Macaron
message: 「What, you didn't notice?」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's right! I've been working super hard for ages to become the Demon Lord!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even coming to the Human World was to prove that I'm a proper Demon Lord!」

name: Ria
message: 「The Demon Lord? No, that can't be right...」

name: Lolotte
